pairs.diagnostic: Our aim is fewer missed delivery windows. Operations' view is that drivers are assigned too many stops; dispatch's view is that parcels leave the depot too late. Neither explanation has been established as fact. Before choosing any changes, what evidence would help us tell these accounts apart?
pairs.decision: To reduce missed delivery windows, assess two possible changes: assigning fewer stops to each route, and bringing forward dispatch from the depot. Neither change has been selected. Explain the effects each could have on missed delivery windows.
